meaning: to understand; to get to know
core: 了解 describes gaining practical, real-world knowledge of a person, situation, or fact. Learners often overuse it to mean deep emotional understanding, which is better expressed by 明白 or 理解 instead.

collocations.en: to find out a little about
to get to know each other

sentences.zh: 我先去了解一下情况，再给你回消息。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiān qù liǎo jiě yī xià qíng kuàng , zài gěi nǐ huí xiāo xi。
sentences.en: I'll go find out the details first, then message you back.
sentences.why: A colleague says this to signal they will gather necessary information before responding, avoiding making assumptions.
sentences.tip: Use 了解一下 when you only need a quick, light check, not a full deep investigation.

sentences.zh: 我想了解一下这款笔记本的价格。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng liǎo jiě yī xià zhè kuǎn bǐ jì běn de jià gé。
sentences.en: I'd like to find out the price of this laptop.
sentences.why: A customer uses this to politely ask for product information without committing to buying immediately.
sentences.tip: This is a standard polite way to ask for product details in stores, much more natural than directly asking 'how much' right away.

sentences.zh: 王总，我已经了解了这个项目的要求。
sentences.pinyin: wáng zǒng , wǒ yǐ jīng liǎo jiě le zhè ge xiàng mù de yāo qiú。
sentences.en: Mr. Wang, I have already understood the requirements of this project.
sentences.why: An employee reports to their manager that they have grasped the task requirements, showing they are ready to start work.
sentences.tip: Add 了 after 了解 to show you have completed the action of understanding.

sentences.situation: At home · talking to your parent
sentences.zh: 你多了解了解我，就知道我不吃辣。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ duō liǎo jiě liǎo jiě wǒ , jiù zhī dào wǒ bù chī là。
sentences.en: If you got to know me better, you would know I don't eat spicy food.
sentences.why: A young person says this to their family member, gently pointing out that the other person does not know their preferences well.
sentences.tip: Repeating 了解了解 makes the tone softer and more casual, perfect for talking to close people.

sentences.situation: At work · talking to a client
sentences.zh: 我们会进一步了解贵公司的需求，做好方案。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men huì jìn yī bù liǎo jiě guì gōng sī de xū qiú , zuò hǎo fāng àn。
sentences.en: We will further understand your company's needs and prepare a good proposal.
sentences.why: A service provider says this to a client to show they will invest time in learning the client's specific needs, building trust.
sentences.tip: 贵 is a formal polite word for 'your', used only when addressing external partners or customers.

sentences.zh: 我们认识时间不长，还需要多互相了解。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men rèn shí shí jiān bù cháng , hái xū yào duō hù xiāng liǎo jiě。
sentences.en: We haven't known each other long, we still need to get to know each other better.
sentences.why: Someone says this to a new friend or romantic interest, setting a gentle pace for the relationship without being cold.
sentences.tip: This phrase is commonly used in early dating or new friendships to signal you want to take time to build trust.

sentences.situation: At a job interview · answering the interviewer
sentences.zh: 来面试前，我已经提前了解了贵公司的业务。
sentences.pinyin: lái miàn shì qián , wǒ yǐ jīng tí qián liǎo jiě le guì gōng sī de yè wù。
sentences.en: Before coming to the interview, I already learned about your company's business in advance.
sentences.why: A job candidate uses this to show they did their homework and are genuinely interested in the company, not just applying randomly.
sentences.tip: Saying this in an interview makes you look much more serious and well-prepared.

sentences.zh: 我最了解你了，你这次已经很努力了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zuì liǎo jiě nǐ le , nǐ zhè cì yǐ jīng hěn nǔ lì le。
sentences.en: I know you better than anyone, you already tried your hardest this time.
sentences.why: A parent says this to their child after a setback, using deep familiarity to offer comfort and validation.
sentences.tip: Adding 最 before 了解 emphasizes deep, long-standing familiarity, perfect for close family moments.

sentences.situation: WeChat message · replying to your colleague
sentences.zh: 行，这个事我大概了解了，你先按之前说的做就行。
sentences.pinyin: xíng , zhè ge shì wǒ dà gài liǎo jiě le , nǐ xiān àn zhī qián shuō de zuò jiù xíng。
sentences.en: Alright, I roughly understand this matter, you can just do it the way we talked about before.
sentences.why: A team lead sends this quick message to confirm they have enough information, giving the colleague clear go-ahead without extra meetings.
sentences.tip: 大概了解 means you have a general grasp, not every tiny detail, which is very common in fast work chats.

sentences.situation: Formal meeting · giving a work report
sentences.zh: 据我了解，这个项目下个月就能正式启动了。
sentences.pinyin: jù wǒ liǎo jiě , zhè ge xiàng mù xià ge yuè jiù néng zhèng shì qǐ dòng le。
sentences.en: As far as I know, this project can officially start next month.
sentences.why: A staff member shares information in a meeting, using 据我了解 to signal this is based on their current knowledge, not an official final announcement.
sentences.tip: Using 据我了解 makes your statement sound more careful and professional, avoiding sounding overly certain of unconfirmed news.

quiz.prompt: You are talking to a shop assistant, and you want to politely ask to learn about the features of a new phone.
quiz.answer: 我想了解一下这款新手机的功能。
accept: 你能给我介绍一下这款新手机吗？
我想了解一下这款手机的情况。
quiz.explain: Using 了解一下 is the standard polite way to ask for product information in a store.

quiz.prompt: You are replying to your colleague who asked about a client issue, tell them you will go find out the details and get back to them later.
quiz.answer: 我先去了解一下情况，稍后给你回消息。
accept: 我先了解下情况，之后再告诉你。
我去了解下这个事，马上回你。
quiz.explain: 了解一下情况 is the natural phrase for gathering work information before responding.

quiz.prompt: You are in a job interview, tell the interviewer that you already learned about their company's products and culture before coming.
quiz.answer: 来面试之前，我已经了解了贵公司的产品和文化。
accept: 我提前了解了贵公司的业务和文化。
面试前我就了解了你们公司的相关情况。
quiz.explain: Stating you researched the company with 了解 shows you are a prepared, serious candidate.

quiz.prompt: You are talking to your close friend, gently saying you two have not known each other very long and need to get to know each other more.
quiz.answer: 我们认识没多久，还需要多互相了解。
accept: 我们还不太熟，得多互相了解一下。
我们认识时间不长，还需要多了解了解。
quiz.explain: 互相了解 is the natural phrase for describing building mutual familiarity in a new relationship.

quiz.prompt: 同事问你：「这个项目的预算定下来了吗？」你只知道大概的情况，还没有拿到最终数字，你会怎么回答？
quiz.answer: 我大概了解了一下，预算应该差不多定了，等我确认完再告诉你。
accept: 据我了解预算基本定了，具体数字我再核实下告诉你。
我大概了解情况了，预算下周就能最终确定。
quiz.explain: Using 大概了解 or 据我了解 shows you have partial information, not final confirmed facts, which is honest and professional.

quiz.prompt: 你妈妈抱怨你总是不记得她不吃甜的东西，你想温柔地回应说你当然最了解她的喜好了，你会怎么说？
quiz.answer: 我最了解你了，你不吃甜的，我都记着的。
accept: 我还不了解你嘛，你不爱吃甜的，我记得牢牢的。
我当然了解你了，你不吃甜的，我怎么会忘。
quiz.explain: Saying 我最了解你了 in a warm tone shows deep familiarity and care, perfect for comforting a family member.
